title: Generalist Meets Specialists: An Evolving Multimodal Agent with Persistent Tool Orchestration for Traffic Scenario Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.25868v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traffic scenario understanding requires combining fine-grained visual evidence with spatial and temporal reasoning. Tool-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) can use specialized perception tools, but effective collaboration faces two challenges: terminal rewards provide limited guidance for intermediate decisions and error recovery, while repeated planning adds unnecessary cost across similar tasks. Echoing the fast-slow dichotomy of human cognition, we propose StarTV-Agent, which combines policy learning with experience evolution to support adaptive reasoning when needed and efficient reuse of prior experience when possible. During training, Role-Sensitive Process Optimization (RSPO) combines process advantages with terminal advantages, while Weakness-Driven Demonstration Learning (WDL) provides validated teacher demonstrations targeting the student's weak questions. translated_title: 通才遇见专家：面向交通场景理解的具备持久工具编排能力的进化型多模态智能体
translated_abstract: 交通场景理解需要将细粒度的视觉证据与空间和时间推理相结合。工具增强的视觉语言模型（VLM）可以使用专门的感知工具，但有效的协作面临两个挑战：终端奖励对中间决策和错误恢复提供的指导有限，而在相似任务上重复规划会带来不必要的成本。呼应人类认知的快慢二分法，我们提出了StarTV-Agent，它将策略学习与经验进化相结合，以在需要时支持自适应推理，并在可能时高效复用先验经验。在训练阶段，角色敏感的过程优化（RSPO）将过程优势与终端优势相结合，而弱点驱动的示范学习（WDL）针对学生的薄弱问题提供经过验证的教师示范。在推理阶段，轻量级自适应工作流复用（LAWR）使……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出StarTV-Agent进化型多模态智能体，通过角色敏感的过程优化（RSPO）、弱点驱动的示范学习（WDL）和轻量级自适应工作流复用（LAWR），将策略学习与经验进化相结合，实现交通场景理解中按需自适应推理与先验经验高效复用的平衡，兼顾准确性与效率。
en_tdlr: We propose StarTV-Agent, an evolving multimodal agent that combines policy learning with experience evolution (RSPO, WDL, and LAWR) for persistent tool orchestration, enabling adaptive reasoning when needed and efficient reuse of prior experience for traffic scenario understanding.
